snippet.title: SECT0R: Cyber Crash - The Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
====================================
Omniverse Staff Team
@Henry68296: Head of Film Department (Owner of this Channel)

@External_VR: Owner of Omniverse

Arzue aka Gemforcegold06: 
Co owner of Omniverse/Beta tester
===================================
From SECT0R: Team we give you a SECT0R Game
Inspired off of Persona. Follow Genesis and her friends
in a new journey following her father's (The Omen) Footsteps.
In the Small town of Ironwood. 
===================================
Music Used: Persona 2: Innocent Sin Demo Trailer Theme
Credits to Atlas/Sega for Trailer Music
===================================
